verdicts.title: On Universal Complexity Measures
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We relate the computational complexity of finite strings to universal representations of their underlying symmetries. First, Boolean functions are classified using the universal covering topologies of the circuits which enumerate them. A binary string is classified as a fixed point of its automorphism group; the irreducible representation of this group is the string's universal covering group.
